data.name: Helium
data.subtitle: Status-bar widgets for TrollStore
data.localizedDescription: Helium adds status-bar widgets to TrollStore iPhones on iOS 14 and up - close the app and the HUD stays on your screen. It also works on jailbroken devices.
data.versionDescription:
Helium 3.2.5 | TrollStore

Massive merge of features from [AsakuraFuuko's repo](https://github.com/AsakuraFuuko/Helium)

**Top features from v3.0.0-v3.2.5 include:**
- Landscape mode now works properly!
- Massive improvements to the adaptive color functionality
- Choosing the text font
- Option for italic text
- Update interval can be controlled for each widget
- New weather widget (must set your own API key)
- Enabling and disabling widget sets
- HUD now updates widget sets without having to restart the HUD
- Option for a debug border around the widgets
- Date locale fixes for Chinese users
- Chinese translation
- A whole lot of other improvements/fixes

Once again, thank you so much to AsakuraFuuko for this huge update. I would like to welcome them to the development team, where they will hopefully continue to update the app! Keep an eye out for this up-and-coming dev 👀

compatibility.notes: TrollStore-named .tipa (byte-identical to an .ipa) from leminlimez/Helium; install with TrollStore, or rename to .ipa if your client rejects the extension. On iOS 16+ you must enable developer mode. Unmaintained since v3.2.5 (February 2024).
